purpose: 固定 Reader 语义放行的逐字段闭合算法，禁止仅凭词面覆盖率或 Claim lineage 生成 supported。

input_contract.field_order: the listed order is canonical and must not be changed

steps: resolve exactly one source frame by source_id/block_id/claim_id and verify its block and claim hashes
for every required field compare candidate and source values after only the declared normalizer
concrete values require one or more non-empty replayable raw-coordinate spans whose text and locator hash match the source frame
unknown and not_applicable are explicit states with an empty span list and never satisfy a Reader-required field
protected semantics must match exactly: subject, predicate, object, action, order, quantity, conditions, polarity and scope
return supported only when every required field is closed and no conflict, ambiguity, copy or unsupported state exists

allowed: collapse internal ASCII whitespace only for comparison

result.supported: all fields closed and protected semantics equivalent
result.blocked: any missing identity, hash, span, field mismatch, conflict, ambiguity, raw copy or forbidden inference
result.audit_only: diagnostic result retained with reason codes but never rendered to Reader

negative_cases.input: lexical coverage >= 0.80 but object or scope differs
Claim lineage exists but one concrete field has no replayable span
unknown or not_applicable is used for subject, predicate, object, polarity or scope
candidate copies the source Claim or rewrites one Claim one-to-one
candidate weakens negation, condition, quantity, order or applicability scope
source block hash, Claim hash or coordinate span hash drifts
